items.question: How many business days can a refund to the original card take in the U.A.E?
items.fact: U.A.E original-card refunds take 7 business days

items.question: Can this retailer refund a payment made with its Pay balance back to a card?
items.gold: No, Careem Pay payments can't be refunded to a card.
items.fact: Pay balance payments cannot be refunded to cards
